fullDescription: Swiss / International-Typographic-Style hero section for an AI design tool: pure white ground, near-black Inter type and one hot signal red. A 12-col grid with a HUGE three-line Inter 800 headline ('Design at / the speed / of thought.') where only the last word is red, an index-rule eyebrow, a single underlined uppercase CTA and a trust row, paired with an angled clip-path 'canvas' panel of floating generated artifacts (red block, component card, swatch chip, prompt tag), a sticky blurred nav and a full-bleed use-case marquee.

structured.summary: A Swiss / International-Typographic-Style hero section for an AI product-design agent. Pure white (#ffffff) ground, near-black ink (#0a0a0a) type and a single hot 'signal' red (#ff3b30) accent. A two-column 12-col grid: a left big-type column carries a HUGE three-line Inter 800 headline on a strict baseline ('Design at / the speed / of thought.') where only the last word is red, an index-rule eyebrow ('AI Product Design --- 01 / Hero'), a tight subhead, a single underlined uppercase CTA, and a baseline trust row; the right column is an angled (clip-path) light-grey canvas-art panel showing floating 'generated artifacts' (a big red block, a white component card, a 3-swatch chip, and a black prompt-cursor tag) with a 'Generated 0.8s' corner index. A sticky blurred white nav sits on top and a full-bleed auto-scrolling uppercase marquee band closes the section. Strict grid, generous whitespace, no decoration that isn't structural.

style.description: Swiss / International Typographic Style, modern SaaS interpretation. Monochrome base (paper white #ffffff ground, ink #0a0a0a text) with exactly one accent: a hot signal red #ff3b30 used for blocks, icons and the single headline accent word, plus an AA-grade darker red #d70015 (5.38:1 on white) reserved for small red text like the eyebrow. Type is all Inter (system fallback), set tight: the display headline is Inter 800 with -0.045em letter-spacing and 0.92 line-height for dense stacked lines; body uses a -0.02em 'grotesk-tight' tracking; labels/eyebrows are uppercase with wide tracking (eyebrow 0.28em, rule 0.18em). Everything snaps to a strict 12-column grid with hairline ink/10 rules and big whitespace. Accents are flat geometric blocks and squares (a rotated red square logo glyph, solid red rectangles, sharp-cornered swatches) with NO rounded corners anywhere and only soft directional drop-shadows on the floating artifacts. A subtle 56px canvas grid texture and an angled clip-path panel add the 'infinite canvas' product cue. Mood: precise, editorial, confident, high-contrast; never soft, gradient-heavy or pastel.
style.prompt: Design in a Swiss / International Typographic Style for a modern AI design tool. Palette is strictly monochrome plus one red: paper #ffffff background, ink #0a0a0a text, signal red #ff3b30 for solid blocks / icons / the single accent word, and a darker AA red #d70015 only for small red text (e.g. the eyebrow). Use Inter for everything (weights 400-900, system-ui fallback) with font-feature-settings cv02/cv03/cv04/cv11. Set type tight and structural: a display class at font-weight 800, letter-spacing -0.045em, line-height 0.92 for the big stacked headline; body text at -0.02em tracking; uppercase eyebrow labels with 0.28em tracking and 'rule' labels with 0.18em tracking. Snap all content to a strict 12-column grid inside a max-w-[1280px] container with px-6/sm:px-8/lg:px-12 gutters, hairline borders at ink/10, and very generous whitespace. Keep every corner sharp (no border-radius). Use flat geometric red blocks and squares as the only graphic language: a 7x7 black tile holding a 45deg-rotated red square as the logo glyph, solid red rectangles, three hard-edged colour swatches (black / red / white-bordered). Add only soft directional drop-shadows (e.g. 0 24px 50px -18px rgba(10,10,10,0.35); the red block gets a red-tinted 0 30px 60px -20px rgba(255,59,48,0.5)). Render a light canvas-art panel (base #f4f4f4) with a 56px repeating-linear-gradient grid in rgba(10,10,10,0.05) and a faint top-right red radial wash, and clip it on an angle via clip-path polygon (desktop polygon(14% 0,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%)). The CTA is text-only: an uppercase 0.18em-tracked bold link with an animated underline (a currentColor 2px background that grows to fill on hover, inverting text to white over red). Mood: precise, editorial, high-contrast Swiss grid, confident and minimal; red is rare and load-bearing.

layout_and_structure.description: A single hero section (not a full page) built on a 12-column grid inside a max-w-[1280px] container, preceded by a sticky blurred white nav and closed by a full-bleed marquee band. The hero splits lg:7 / lg:5: the left big-type column stacks an index-rule eyebrow, a huge three-line headline, a tight subhead, a single underlined CTA, and a bottom-aligned trust row; the right column is an angled clip-path light-grey 'canvas' panel that bleeds slightly off the right edge (lg:right-[-48px]) and holds four absolutely-positioned floating 'generated artifacts' plus a corner index label. Responsive: below lg the grid collapses to one column, the angle flips (clip-path polygon(0 12%,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%)) and the panel becomes a fixed-height (~280px) stacked block, the nav center links and trust row hide, and the headline clamps down from ~7.8rem to ~3rem.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (z-50) with a translucent white background (bg-paper/90) + backdrop-blur and a hairline ink/10 bottom border. Inside a max-w-[1280px] row at h-16 / lg:h-[72px]: left = the brand, a 7x7 (h-7 w-7) solid black (ink) tile with a place-items-center 45deg-rotated 2.5x2.5 red (signal) square inside it, next to a two-line lockup ('Prism' in 15px Inter 800 tight tracking, and a tiny 8.5px uppercase 0.28em-tracked 'Design Agent' label in ink/65). Center (hidden below lg) = four 13px medium text links in ink/70 that darken on hover: Library, Canvas, Skill, Pricing. Right = a 'Sign in' text link (hidden on mobile) and a sharp-cornered black (ink) button 'Start free' (13px semibold, white text, px-4 py-2) with a lucide:arrow-right icon that nudges right on hover and whose background flips to red (signal) on hover.

The left column (lg:col-span-7, pt-28 pb-32 on desktop, pr-12). Top: an index-rule eyebrow row -- an uppercase 11.5px 0.28em-tracked bold 'AI Product Design' in the darker red (signal-ink #d70015), a flex-1 hairline ink/15 rule capped at 120px, and an uppercase 11px 0.18em-tracked '01 / Hero' label in ink/65. Then a HUGE three-line headline using the display class (Inter 800, -0.045em, line-height 0.92) sized text-[clamp(4.4rem,8vw,7.8rem)] on desktop / clamp(3rem,12vw,5.6rem) mobile, each line in its own block: 'Design at' / 'the speed' / 'of <thought.>' where only 'thought.' is signal red. Below, a tight subhead at 16.5px leading-relaxed ink/60, max-w-[34ch]: 'Prism turns a sentence into shippable UI. Mockups, components, full screens, generated on an infinite canvas and driven straight from your coding agent.' Then a single text-only CTA: an uppercase 17px 0.18em-tracked bold link 'Start designing' with an animated growing underline and a lucide:arrow-up-right icon that translates on hover (hover fills the underline to a red block with white text). Finally a mt-auto bottom trust row (hidden below lg): three 12px ink/65 items separated by short vertical ink/15 rules, each a small red lucide icon + label -- infinity 'Infinite canvas', terminal 'Claude Code & Cursor', library '900+ prompt library'. Use staggered fade-up entrance animations (d1..d6).

The right column (lg:col-span-5). A 'canvas-art' panel that on desktop is absolutely positioned to fill the column height and bleed off the right edge (lg:inset-y-0 lg:left-0 lg:right-[-48px]); on mobile it is a ~280px-tall stacked block. The panel is clipped on an angle via clip-path (desktop polygon(14% 0,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%); mobile polygon(0 12%,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%)) and filled with the canvas-art background: a #f4f4f4 base, a 56px repeating-linear-gradient grid in rgba(10,10,10,0.05) both axes, and a faint top-right red radial wash. Inside, four absolutely-positioned floating 'generated artifacts': (1) a big solid red (signal) block (top-[16%] right-[14%], w-46% h-34%) with a red-tinted drop shadow; (2) a white component-card mock (top-[42%] left-[26%], w-44%, soft shadow, p-4) containing a 'COMPONENT' eyebrow with a small red square, two ink bars (3/4 and 1/2 width) and two mock buttons (one solid black, one ink/25-bordered ghost); (3) a 3-swatch chip near the bottom (black / red / white-bordered squares, each h-7 w-7) with a soft shadow; (4) a black prompt-cursor tag (top-[13%] left-[~25%]) reading '"a pricing page, swiss style"' with a red lucide:sparkles icon. Plus a bottom-left corner index: uppercase 10px 0.18em-tracked 'Generated · 0.8s' in ink/70 (desktop only).

A full-bleed band closing the section, with hairline ink/10 top+bottom borders on a white ground, overflow hidden. Inside, two identical horizontal track groups animate left forever (transform translateX 0 -> -50% over ~26s linear, the second aria-hidden) so the loop is seamless. Each group is a row of uppercase 12px 0.18em-tracked semibold ink/65 labels with px-7 py-3.5 padding, each followed by a tiny red lucide:asterisk separator: Landing pages, Dashboards, Mobile apps, Design systems, Email templates, Onboarding flows.

special_ui_components.prompt: Index-rule eyebrow: an uppercase wide-tracked red label + a capped hairline rule + a '01 / Hero' section index, a Swiss editorial signature
Huge stacked display headline: Inter 800, -0.045em tracking, 0.92 line-height, one block per line, clamp-scaled, with a single red accent word ('thought.')
Animated underline CTA: a text-only uppercase link whose 2px currentColor underline grows to a full red block with inverted white text on hover (cta-underline class)
Angled clip-path 'canvas' panel: a light #f4f4f4 panel with a 56px line-grid texture, faint red radial wash, clipped on an angle (and the angle flips on mobile)

Floating 'generated artifacts' inside the canvas: a solid red block (red-tinted shadow), a white component-card mock (eyebrow + ink bars + two mock buttons), a 3-square colour swatch chip, and a black prompt-cursor tag with a red sparkles icon
Rotated-square logo glyph: a black tile holding a 45deg-rotated red square
Sharp-cornered black CTA button that flips to red on hover with a nudging arrow icon
Seamless CSS marquee band of uppercase use-case labels separated by red asterisks
Staggered fade-up entrance animations (d1..d6) on the left column
Lucide (Iconify) icons: arrow-right, arrow-up-right, infinity, terminal, library, sparkles, asterisk

structured.special_notes: Single hero SECTION (sticky nav + hero + marquee), not a full page. Font: Inter only, loaded from Google Fonts (weights 400/500/600/700/800/900), system-ui/sans-serif fallback, with font-feature-settings cv02/cv03/cv04/cv11 and -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased. Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme: colors ink #0a0a0a, paper #ffffff, signal #ff3b30, signal-ink #d70015 (AA 5.38:1 red for small text on white -- blocks/icons keep the brighter signal). Canvas panel base #f4f4f4 with a 56px rgba(10,10,10,0.05) repeating-linear-gradient grid. Keep all corners sharp (no border-radius) and red strictly rare and load-bearing -- it should appear only on the one accent word, the logo square, the big block, the swatch, and small icons. Maintain the strict 12-col grid, generous whitespace and AA contrast (small red text uses signal-ink, not signal). Responsive: collapse to one column below lg, flip the panel clip angle, hide the nav center links and trust row, and clamp the headline down.
